subject: MIMO-4: Mondrian CQR v2 Reaches Holdout Coverage + ML CLV Fixed
body: CORRECTED HONEST RESULTS. M2 hex32 multi-league ESPN: 2040/2087 RESOLVED = 97.75% (47 unresolved, 0 silent defaults) — target >=90% EXCEEDED; 100% not claimed. M1 Mondrian CQR v2/v3: best mode B_quantile_bands K3 holdout cov 0.770 (sport-sigma v2 got 0.803); ALL modes still KILL_cov_lt_0.85 on K3; target 0.890 NOT met. MECHANISM: K3 holdout |resid| p90=26.5 vs cal p90=19.0 (K1 te p90=27 vs cal 10.7) — non-exchangeable blowout/key-number scale; cal-derived qhat cannot reach 0.89 without leakage or unbounded bands. STRENGTH: fail-closed No-band on K3/thin K1 + rolling-origin when m>=32 in-stratum; Mondrian still beats pooled min cov 0.54->0.74+. M3 ML CLV: baseline non-push 14.2% [10.0,19.9] n=190 CONFIRMED. Filters A edge>=3pp n=2 THIN; B not-heavy-fav 9.7% WORSE; C books>=10 28.9% [17.7,43.4] best powered but <50; NO filter meets kill line (>=50%, LB>0.40, n>=30). mean(p_model-mfp)=-0.28 on n=84 — engine often prices ML below market. REPLACEMENT: totals-first CLV (TOTAL 56.7% [52.2,61.1]); ML withheld from beat-close claims; publish market-implied vs model p side-by-side; no gate flip. Artifacts MIMO4_REPORT_2026-09-19.md + out/mondrian_cqr_v2_results.json + moneyline_clv_turnaround.json + resolved_game_ids_v2.json.
